brief.meaningEn: Distinguish claims supported by reliable evidence from invented or unsupported stories.
brief.meaningZh: 以可靠證據分辨有根據的事實與編造或無根據的說法。
brief.grammar: Separate fact from fiction is a fixed paired phrase; separate inflects separated. It calls for checking evidence, not labelling every uncertain claim false.
brief.register: Neutral public and educational English. A librarian may use it when teaching readers to verify an online claim.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有查核來源與證據的過程；未證實不一定已證偽，亦不能把喜歡的故事自動當事實。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是按文字是否有趣分類，也不是只憑說話者身份就斷定真偽。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出待核查主張、所用可靠資料，以及已證實與未確定的界線。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 226, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Science lessons help pupils separate fact from fiction.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: An online post said the town bridge would close tomorrow. The librarian checked the council notice: only the footpath beside it would close. This helped readers separate fact from fiction about the bridge.
listening.zh: 網上貼文說鎮上的橋明天會封閉。圖書館員查閱區議會通知，發現只有橋旁行人徑會關閉。這有助讀者分辨關於那座橋的事實與虛構。
listening.promptZh: 哪項說法得到官方通知支持？

options.en: Only the footpath beside the bridge will close.
options.zh: 只有橋旁行人徑會關閉。

options.en: The entire bridge will close to all traffic.
options.zh: 整條橋會對所有車輛封閉。

options.en: The council has cancelled all repairs.
options.zh: 區議會取消了所有維修。

options.en: The footpath will remain open tomorrow.
options.zh: 行人徑明天仍開放。

listening.explanationZh: 官方通知支持行人徑關閉，而非整橋封閉。

reply.promptEn: A video claims a public garden is being sold. The team checks the land register and a current council plan; neither shows a sale, but a lease review is pending. What is the responsible approach?
reply.promptZh: （影片聲稱公共花園正在出售。團隊查核土地登記冊及現行區議會計劃；兩者都沒有出售紀錄，但租約檢討尚未完成。負責任的做法是甚麼？）

options.en: Say the sale claim lacks support in the checked records.
options.zh: 指出已查紀錄未支持出售說法。

options.en: Distinguish the pending lease review from a completed sale.
options.zh: 分清尚待完成的租約檢討與已完成出售。

options.en: Separate fact from fiction using the records and state what remains unknown.
options.zh: 依紀錄分辨事實與虛構，並說明仍未知之處。

options.en: Avoid claiming the future lease decision is already settled.
options.zh: 避免聲稱日後租約決定已成定案。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均依已查資料作有界判斷。

scene.promptZh: 有人說學校游泳池下月永久關閉；校方公告只說兩週維修。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Check the notice to separate fact from fiction about the closure.
options.zh: 查公告，分辨關閉傳聞中的事實與虛構。

options.en: Treat the two-week repair as proof of permanent closure.
options.zh: 把兩週維修當作永久關閉的證據。

options.en: Assume the rumour is true because it was repeated often.
options.zh: 因傳聞被多次重複，便認定是真的。

scene.explanationZh: 公告內容與永久關閉說法不同，須按證據區分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 someone separated fact from fiction？

options.en: They forward a dramatic claim without checking the named source or current notice.
options.zh: 他們未核對所提來源或現行公告，便轉發誇張說法。

options.en: They compare a rumour with a signed official notice and note the difference.
options.zh: 他們把傳聞與簽署的官方通知比較，指出差異。

options.en: They check two primary records and say which part remains uncertain.
options.zh: 他們查閱兩項第一手紀錄，說明哪部分仍未確定。

contrast.explanationZh: 未查來源便轉發，沒有分辨證據。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The message says every library branch closes next week, but the official notice names only one branch for a two-day repair. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：訊息說每間圖書館分館下週都關閉，但官方通知只列出一間分館因維修關閉兩天。乙：______）

options.en: The notice helps us separate fact from fiction in that message.
options.zh: 通知有助我們分辨訊息中的事實與虛構。

options.en: Only one branch and two days are confirmed here.
options.zh: 這裏只確認一間分館及兩天。

options.en: The message goes beyond what the official notice states.
options.zh: 訊息所說超出官方通知內容。

options.en: We should share the limited confirmed information, not the wider claim.
options.zh: 我們應分享有限的確認資料，不應分享較廣泛的說法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句以官方通知核對傳聞，並限制結論範圍。

speaking.en: The school newspaper separated fact from fiction by checking the timetable before reporting that the concert was delayed by one hour, not cancelled.
speaking.zh: 校報先核對時間表，分辨事實與虛構，才報道音樂會只是延遲一小時，而非取消。
speaking.promptZh: 用具體核查與修正後的結論作證。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩項網上說法各含誇大或未證實部分。用英文寫出主張、核查資料及有界結論。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例要標明已證實與仍未知的部分，不可把未查證直接說成假的。

examples.en: A post claimed the sports centre would close for a year; staff checked the published schedule and separated fact from fiction: only the pool closes for three weeks, with later dates unconfirmed.
examples.zh: 貼文聲稱體育中心會關閉一年；職員查閱公布時間表，分辨事實與虛構：只有泳池關閉三週，之後日期未獲確認。

examples.en: The rumour said every bus route would change. The transport notice let Mei separate fact from fiction: Route 6 has a new stop, while no other change is listed yet.
examples.zh: 傳聞說每條巴士路線都會改動。交通通知讓美分辨事實與虛構：六號線有新站，暫未列出其他改動。

takeaways.en: Separate fact from fiction means test claims against evidence.
takeaways.zh: separate fact from fiction 指依證據檢驗說法。

takeaways.en: State what remains unknown when you separate fact from fiction.
takeaways.zh: 分辨事實與虛構時，也要說明仍未知之處。

lessons.titleEn: sort out the details of a plan

target.pattern: \b(?:sort|sorts|sorted|sorting) out (?:the same plan|(?:a|the|our|their) (?:shared )?plan|(?:the|our|their) details of (?:(?:a|the|our|their) (?:shared |single )?plan|the (?:rehearsal|delivery|picnic|camping|walking|clean-up) plan))\b

brief.meaningEn: Discuss and settle the practical details of a plan so participants know what to do.
brief.meaningZh: 商量並確定計劃的實際細節，讓參與者知道各自如何行動。
brief.grammar: Use sort out + a/the plan, or more explicitly sort out the details of a shared plan. The phrasal verb is transferable to other practical details or arrangements. The source wording “sort out the same plan” is understandable but awkward without a competing-plan context; it is provenance, not the model to imitate. Sort inflects to sorted/sorting.
brief.register: Informal everyday English. Friends may use it while arranging travel or a community task together.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有時間、分工或地點等細節獲確定；只有「應該計劃一下」而未釐清安排，不算商量妥。原文 sort out the same plan 的 same 不是必須沿用的固定部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是按字母次序整理紙張，也不是把 same plan 當成必須照抄的固定搭配。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用自然的 sort out the details of a plan 說明待定細節、協商結果及參與者的確認。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 228, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Friends can sort out the same plan in a few messages.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: Two friends expected different arrival times for a charity run. They checked the opening time, agreed to meet at the north gate at eight and chose who would bring water. They sorted out the details of a shared plan before leaving.
listening.zh: 兩位朋友原本預計不同到達時間。他們核對開場時間，同意八時在北門見面，並決定由誰帶水。離開前，他們商量妥共同計劃的細節。
listening.promptZh: 哪些細節顯示計劃已商量妥？

options.en: They agreed on meeting time, place and who brings water.
options.zh: 他們同意見面時間、地點及誰帶水。

options.en: They kept different arrival times and never compared them.
options.zh: 他們仍各有不同到達時間，從未核對。

options.en: They only said they might meet sometime next week.
options.zh: 他們只說或許下週某時見面。

options.en: They assumed the organiser would bring everything without checking.
options.zh: 他們未查便假設主辦方會帶齊所有東西。

listening.explanationZh: 雙方確定時間、地點及分工，形成同一安排。

reply.promptEn: A group plans a neighbourhood clean-up. Members compare two start times, agree on nine, assign gloves to Ben and confirm the meeting point in one message everyone acknowledges. What did they do?
reply.promptZh: （一組人規劃鄰里清潔活動。成員比較兩個開始時間，商定九時，由本負責手套，並在一則大家都確認的訊息中定下集合地點。他們做了甚麼？）

options.en: They settled the time, place and one responsibility.
options.zh: 他們確定時間、地點及一項分工。

options.en: Everyone confirmed one shared arrangement.
options.zh: 大家確認同一安排。

options.en: They sorted out the details of a single plan everyone can follow.
options.zh: 他們商量妥一套大家都能依循的計劃細節。

options.en: The acknowledged message reduces conflicting versions.
options.zh: 獲確認的訊息減少出現不同版本。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據共同確認的細節回答。

scene.promptZh: 四位朋友對露營集合時間有不同理解；他們查交通時間後，在同一群組訊息確認十時於東站會合、各帶一瓶水。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They sorted out the details of their shared plan.
options.zh: 他們商量妥共同計劃的細節。

options.en: They kept four conflicting meeting times.
options.zh: 他們仍維持四個互相矛盾的集合時間。

options.en: They only promised to make a plan later.
options.zh: 他們只答應日後再訂計劃。

scene.explanationZh: 共同確認具體細節，使安排一致。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 friends sorted out the details of a plan？

options.en: Each friend keeps a different meeting place, and nobody confirms which one to use.
options.zh: 每位朋友各用不同集合地點，沒有人確認該用哪個。

options.en: They agree on a place, time and shared equipment list.
options.zh: 他們同意地點、時間及共同器材清單。

options.en: They settle the route and tell every participant the agreed version.
options.zh: 他們確定路線並告知每名參與者同一版本。

contrast.explanationZh: 地點未定且各說各話，尚未商量妥。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The team had three versions of the picnic plan. We checked the weather, agreed on the covered park at noon and posted one equipment list that everyone confirmed. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：團隊原有三個野餐安排版本。我們查過天氣，商定中午到有蓋公園，並貼出一份大家都確認的器材清單。乙：______）

options.en: You sorted out the details of a shared plan for everyone.
options.zh: 你們替大家商量妥共同計劃的細節。

options.en: The shared post should reduce conflicting instructions.
options.zh: 共同訊息應可減少相互矛盾的指示。

options.en: The time, place and equipment are now aligned.
options.zh: 時間、地點及器材安排已一致。

options.en: Everyone has confirmed the agreed version.
options.zh: 大家都確認了獲同意的版本。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句概括由三個版本變成一套已確認安排。

speaking.en: The walking group sorted out the details of their shared plan after comparing ferry times: all six members confirmed the eight-thirty departure and who would carry the route map.
speaking.zh: 步行小組比較渡輪時間後商量妥共同計劃的細節：六名成員都確認八時半出發，亦確定由誰帶路線圖。
speaking.promptZh: 具體說明共同版本及分工。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩組人原有不一致的安排，透過核查與協商定下一套共同計劃，並得到參與者確認。用英文寫出前後變化。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例要有可核實的時間、地點或分工，不能只說「我們談過了」。

examples.en: The choir had two rehearsal times in circulation; after checking room availability, members sorted out the details of their shared plan and confirmed Tuesday at six in Hall B.
examples.zh: 合唱團原流傳兩個綵排時間；成員核查房間後商量妥共同計劃的細節，確認星期二六時在B禮堂。

examples.en: Three helpers disagreed about the delivery route, but they checked the road closure, sorted out the details of their shared plan and acknowledged one updated map before leaving.
examples.zh: 三名幫手對送貨路線有分歧，但他們核查封路，商量妥共同計劃的細節，並在出發前確認同一張更新地圖。

takeaways.en: Sort out the details of a shared plan means settle the practical arrangement together.
takeaways.zh: sort out the details of a shared plan 指一起商量妥實際安排。

takeaways.en: After you sort out the details of a plan, check that everyone agrees.
takeaways.zh: 商量妥計劃細節後，要確認大家同意。

brief.meaningEn: Immediately at that point in a conversation or event, without delaying the decision or action.
brief.meaningZh: 在當時當場立即作出決定或行動，沒有延後。
brief.grammar: There and then is a fixed adverbial phrase. It emphasises immediate timing, not merely a physical location.
brief.register: Neutral conversational English. A coordinator may use it when recounting a decision made during a meeting.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有當時即時處理的證據；先承諾稍後做，或當場只討論未決，不等於當場完成。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是「去那裏然後」的兩個步驟，也不表示未經必要查核的倉促決定值得稱讚。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出觸發事件、即時行動及是否完成或只開始處理。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 229, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A phone call asks for attention there and then.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: During the gallery meeting, staff noticed the printed route map sent wheelchair users to a stair-only entrance. After checking the approved accessible path, the coordinator corrected the map there and then before the next group arrived.
listening.zh: 藝廊會議期間，職員發現印製路線圖把輪椅使用者帶往只有樓梯的入口。協調員核查獲批准的無障礙路線後，當場立即改正地圖，趕在下一批訪客到達前。

options.en: During that meeting, after the route was checked.
options.zh: 在那次會議當場，核查路線後。

options.en: Several weeks after the next group had visited.
options.zh: 下一批訪客到訪數週後。

options.en: Before anyone noticed the stair-only entrance.
options.zh: 有人留意到只有樓梯的入口之前。

options.en: Only after a later unrelated meeting.
options.zh: 另一次無關會議之後才更正。

listening.explanationZh: 更正發生於發現問題的同一會議。

reply.promptEn: At a rehearsal, the stage manager sees an unsafe loose cable. She stops the run, asks a technician to secure it, verifies the fix and updates the cue sheet before restarting. When did she address it?
reply.promptZh: （綵排時，舞台經理看到一條鬆脫而不安全的電線。她暫停綵排，請技術員固定、核查修好情況，並在重開前更新提示表。她何時處理？）

options.en: She dealt with it during the rehearsal, before restarting.
options.zh: 她在綵排當時、重開之前處理。

options.en: She did not postpone the safety issue until the next show.
options.zh: 她沒有把安全問題拖到下次演出。

options.en: She addressed it there and then after a proper check.
options.zh: 她經適當核查後便當場處理。

options.en: The cable and cue sheet were checked in the same session.
options.zh: 電線與提示表在同一節綵排核查。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均按當場暫停、修好、核查回答。

scene.promptZh: 接待處發現當天票價標示錯誤，職員核對已批准價目表後，立刻在同一櫃位更換標示。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They corrected the sign there and then.
options.zh: 他們當場立即改正標示。

options.en: They only promised to replace it next month.
options.zh: 他們只答應下月更換。

options.en: They made the change before checking any authorised price.
options.zh: 他們未核對獲批准價目便改動。

scene.explanationZh: 核對後在同一事件中即時更正。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 a decision was made there and then？

options.en: The committee discussed the issue but scheduled the actual decision for next Friday.
options.zh: 委員會討論了問題，卻把真正決定定在下週五。

options.en: After checking the list, the organiser approved the correction during that meeting.
options.zh: 主辦人核對清單後，在該次會議批准修正。

options.en: The team saw the error and fixed it before leaving the room.
options.zh: 團隊看到錯誤，在離開房間前修好。

contrast.explanationZh: 只是當場討論，決定延後。

dialogue.promptEn: A: We found a duplicate name on the attendance sheet during registration. After checking both records, Mei corrected it at the desk before the queue moved. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：登記期間，我們在出席表發現重複姓名。美核對兩份紀錄後，在隊伍移動前於櫃位改正。乙：______）

options.en: She fixed the duplicate there and then.
options.zh: 她當場立即改正重複紀錄。

options.en: The correction happened during the same registration period.
options.zh: 更正發生在同一次登記期間。

options.en: She checked the evidence before changing the list.
options.zh: 她修改清單前先核查證據。

options.en: The next people in line saw a corrected sheet.
options.zh: 下一批排隊者看到更正後的名單。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出有核查、沒有延後的即時修正。

speaking.en: When the workshop leader learned that the posted room number was wrong, she checked the booking email and changed the sign there and then, before attendees followed the old notice.
speaking.zh: 工作坊領隊得知張貼房號錯誤後，核對預約電郵並當場更換標示，趕在參加者按舊通知走錯之前。
speaking.promptZh: 強調同一時刻有核查的即時行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩人在同一事件中發現錯誤，完成必要核查後當場處理，而非拖到後日。用英文寫出發現、核查與即時行動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例要顯示當場確實行動；只說「稍後會做」不算 there and then。

examples.en: At the ticket desk, Bea spotted an outdated fee, checked the approved price list and replaced the card there and then before the next sale.
examples.zh: 售票櫃位上，碧亞發現過時收費，核對已批准價目表，並在下一宗交易前當場更換價卡。

examples.en: During the map briefing, the guide found the wrong lift symbol, confirmed the correct entrance and amended the shared map there and then.
examples.zh: 地圖簡介期間，導遊發現升降機標誌錯誤，確認正確入口後，當場修正共用地圖。

takeaways.en: There and then means immediately at that point.
takeaways.zh: there and then 指當時當場立即。

takeaways.en: A checked correction can still be made there and then.
takeaways.zh: 核查後仍可當場立即作出修正。

brief.meaningEn: Respond to a request while not abandoning all current work or commitments.
brief.meaningZh: 回應請求時，不把手頭全部工作或承諾拋開。
brief.grammar: Without dropping everything is an adverbial phrase. Drop everything alone means abandon current activity immediately; the negative phrase describes a balanced response.
brief.register: Conversational everyday English. A team lead may use it when setting a realistic time for a non-urgent request.
brief.boundaryZh: 要分清請求是否緊急，並交代目前任務如何繼續；不是藉口永不回覆，也不適用於需要即時安全處理的危急情況。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是字面把所有物品掉在地上，也不能以延遲處理真正緊急事故來展示「平衡」。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出清楚回覆時間或轉交方式，同時保護正在進行的必要工作。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 229, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She can reply later without dropping everything.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: During a scheduled medication count, the clinic clerk receives a non-urgent request for next month’s leaflet. She acknowledges it, promises a draft after the count and finishes the required check without dropping everything.
listening.zh: 診所文員按計劃核對藥物數量期間，收到下月單張的非緊急要求。她先確認收到，答應核對完後起草，並沒有放下手頭所有事，仍完成必要檢查。
listening.promptZh: 文員如何平衡兩項工作？

options.en: She acknowledges the later task but completes the current required count.
options.zh: 她確認較後的工作，但先完成眼前必需核對。

options.en: She ignores the leaflet request indefinitely.
options.zh: 她永久不理會單張要求。

options.en: She abandons the count midway without arranging cover.
options.zh: 她在核對中途放棄，亦沒安排接手。

options.en: She treats the leaflet as an immediate safety emergency.
options.zh: 她把單張當成即時安全事故。

listening.explanationZh: 非緊急新要求得到回覆，當前必需工作沒有被拋下。

reply.promptEn: A community editor is checking today’s printed safety signs. A colleague asks for ideas for next month’s newsletter. The editor says she will discuss it at four after the sign check and notes the request. What did she do?
reply.promptZh: （社區編輯正在核對今天要印的安全標示。同事請她為下月通訊提供想法。她記下要求，說核對標示後四時再討論。她做了甚麼？）

options.en: She gave a definite later time for the non-urgent request.
options.zh: 她為非緊急要求提出明確稍後時間。

options.en: She kept the current sign check on course.
options.zh: 她維持正在進行的標示核對。

options.en: She responded without dropping everything.
options.zh: 她回應了，沒有放下手頭所有事。

options.en: The colleague has a clear plan for when to discuss the ideas.
options.zh: 同事清楚知道何時討論構想。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均支持有回應而不打斷較迫切的工作。

scene.promptZh: 導賞員正在按程序帶團，收到下週活動的非緊急電郵；他回覆說導賞後核對細節，並繼續帶團。哪句最貼切？

options.en: He replied without dropping everything.
options.zh: 他回覆了，沒有放下手頭所有事。

options.en: He abandoned the visitors to answer a next-week message at length.
options.zh: 他放下訪客，長篇回覆下週的訊息。

options.en: He refused ever to consider the new event.
options.zh: 他拒絕日後考慮新活動。

scene.explanationZh: 有明確稍後處理時間，當前責任繼續。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 someone responded without dropping everything？

options.en: She leaves an essential safety check unfinished to write a long answer to a non-urgent request.
options.zh: 她放下尚未完成的必要安全檢查，為非緊急要求寫長篇回覆。

options.en: She acknowledges the request and sets a time after the current task.
options.zh: 她確認收到要求，訂在手頭工作完成後處理。

options.en: She asks a colleague to handle a routine query while she finishes a scheduled check.
options.zh: 她完成原定核對時，請同事處理例行查詢。

contrast.explanationZh: 因非緊急要求而拋下必要工作，正是反例。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The team is checking the visitor count for today’s report. I also want ideas for next month’s display; there is no urgent deadline. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：團隊正核對今天報告的訪客數。我也想聽聽下月展示的構想，但沒有緊迫期限。乙：______）

options.en: We can answer without dropping everything right now.
options.zh: 我們現在可回應，而不必放下手頭所有事。

options.en: The count needs to be completed for today’s report.
options.zh: 今天報告所需的人數核對應先完成。

options.en: We can note your request and discuss it after the count.
options.zh: 我們可先記下要求，核對人數後再討論。

options.en: A clear later meeting time would keep both tasks moving.
options.zh: 訂明稍後開會時間，可讓兩項工作繼續。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句用明確回覆時間兼顧手頭任務。

speaking.en: The translator acknowledged the non-urgent poster request and offered a review slot after finishing the live-caption check, responding without dropping everything.
speaking.zh: 譯者先確認收到非緊急海報要求，並提出完成即時字幕核對後再審閱，既有回應，也沒有放下手頭所有事。
speaking.promptZh: 回覆與目前責任同時得到安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩人正做有時限的必要任務，收到可稍後處理的要求。用英文寫出簡短回覆、具體處理時間及現有任務如何繼續。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不能把真正緊急安全情況當成可延遲；也不能完全無視新要求。

examples.en: While checking the festival’s accessibility signs, Lian acknowledged a request for next month’s poster and booked a review for Friday without dropping everything.
examples.zh: 蓮核對節慶無障礙標示時，先確認收到下月海報要求，並約好星期五審閱，沒有放下手頭所有事。

examples.en: The librarian finished the scheduled archive count after telling a colleague she would answer the non-urgent exhibition email at three, without dropping everything.
examples.zh: 圖書館員告訴同事三時會回覆非緊急展覽電郵後，先完成原定檔案點算，沒有放下手頭所有事。

takeaways.en: Without dropping everything means responding while keeping current commitments in view.
takeaways.zh: without dropping everything 指回應時仍顧及手頭責任。

takeaways.en: Give a clear later time when answering without dropping everything.
takeaways.zh: 不放下手頭所有事而回應時，要給出明確稍後處理時間。
